```{r}
#Load wide data 

person_wide <- read_csv(paste0(data_dir,"matched_within_cohort_grad_non_grad_tight.csv"),
                        show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(
    subclass            = match_pair_id,
    log_earn_1yr        = log_earnings_1yr_preTIP,
    log_earn_2yr        = log_earnings_2yr_preTIP,
    job_pre_1yr         = job_right_before_tip,
    max_ogs_before      = max_ogs_before_start,
    num_sentences_before = num_sentences_before_start,
    any_sentence_before = any_sentence_before_start,
    employed_full_post_18m  = full_employed_18mo_postTIP,
    employed_part_post_18m  = any_employed_18mo_postTIP,
    any_offense_18m         = offense_outcome            
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment           = as.integer(treatment),
    cohort_2022         = as.integer(cohort_2022),
    any_sentence_before = as.integer(any_sentence_before),
    age_band            = factor(age_band),
    race                = factor(replace_na(as.character(race),   "Unknown")),
    gender              = factor(replace_na(as.character(gender), "Unknown")),
    #within_time_window already 0/1 from Python; use as full_window
    full_window     = as.integer(within_time_window)
  )
```

```{r}
#Load and clean panel data
panel_a <- read_csv(paste0(data_dir,"matched_panel_data_grad_non_grad_tight.csv"),
                    show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(
    earnings_year_adj   = earnings_full_year,
    offended_year       = offended_year
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment     = as.integer(treatment),
    cohort_2022   = as.integer(cohort_2022),
    graduated_tip = as.integer(graduated_tip),
    # rel_year: years relative to TIP end year
    rel_year      = year - end_year,
    rel_year_bin  = as.integer(case_when(
      rel_year <= -4 ~ -4L,
      rel_year >=  4 ~  4L,
      TRUE           ~ as.integer(rel_year)
    ))
  )

# Attach subclass from person_wide so panel rows can be stratified by matched pair
panel_a <- panel_a %>%
  left_join(person_wide %>% select(tip_id, subclass), by = "tip_id")

cat("Loaded:", nrow(person_wide), "matched individuals |",
    nrow(panel_a), "person-years\n\n")
```

```{r}

cat("\nPost-exit 18m outcomes (person-level):\n")
person_wide %>%
  group_by(treatment, cohort_2022) %>%
  summarise(
    employed_full_18m = round(mean(employed_full_post_18m, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
```

```{r}
#DIFFERENCE IN DIFFERENCE MODELS FIXED EFFECT OLS MODELS

# rel_year == 0 is the exit year; rel_year == 1 is the first full year after.
# 2-year window (0, 1) is to align as best as possible with our 18mo binary
# outcomes that we'll test later using conditional logit

daw <- panel_a %>% filter(rel_year <= 1)
cat("Annual windowed N:", nrow(daw), "| Individuals:", n_distinct(daw$tip_id), "\n\n")

lpm_full_a <- feols(employed_full_year  ~ graduated_tip + graduated_tip:cohort_2022 |
                      tip_id + year, cluster = ~tip_id, data = daw)
lpm_part_a <- feols(employed_partial_year ~ graduated_tip + graduated_tip:cohort_2022 |
                      tip_id + year, cluster = ~tip_id, data = daw)
lpm_off_a  <- feols(offended_year       ~ graduated_tip + graduated_tip:cohort_2022 |
                      tip_id + year, cluster = ~tip_id, data = daw)
ols_earn_a <- feols(log(earnings_year_adj + 1) ~ graduated_tip + graduated_tip:cohort_2022 |
                      tip_id + year, cluster = ~tip_id, data = daw)

```

```{r}
#Employment DiD model (full employment, employed at every point in period)
```

```{r}
#CONDITIONAL LOGIT (18 MONTH POST TIP OUTCOMES)
tidy_clogit <- function(model, label) {
  tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(grepl("graduated_tip|treatment", term)) %>%
    select(term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) %>%
    mutate(label = label, OR = round(exp(estimate), 3),
           OR_lo = round(exp(conf.low), 3), OR_hi = round(exp(conf.high), 3),
           .before = term)
}

# Person-level 18m clogit — restrict to within_time_window == 1
# need to make sure individuals have both pre and post data for the logit
person_m2 <- person_wide %>%
  filter(full_window == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    cohort_2022         = as.integer(cohort_2022),
    treatment           = as.integer(treatment),
    any_sentence_before = as.integer(any_sentence_before)
  )

cat("\nPerson-level 18m clogit N:", nrow(person_m2),
    "| Pairs:", n_distinct(person_m2$subclass), "\n")

mp_full <- clogit(employed_full_post_18m ~ treatment + treatment:cohort_2022 +
                    any_sentence_before + strata(subclass),
                  data = person_m2, method = "efron")
mp_part <- clogit(employed_part_post_18m ~ treatment + treatment:cohort_2022 +
                    any_sentence_before + strata(subclass),
                  data = person_m2, method = "efron")
mp_off  <- clogit(any_offense_18m ~ treatment + treatment:cohort_2022 +
                    any_sentence_before + strata(subclass),
                  data = person_m2, method = "efron")

```


```{r}
cat("\nResults (OR scale):\n")
print(bind_rows(
  tidy_clogit(mp_full, "Employed (full, 18m)"),
  tidy_clogit(mp_part, "Employed (partial, 18m)"),
  tidy_clogit(mp_off,  "Any offense (18m)")
), n = Inf)

for (nm in c("mp_full", "mp_part", "mp_off")) {
  cat(nm, ":\n")
  tryCatch(
    print(linearHypothesis(get(nm), "treatment + treatment:cohort_2022 = 0")),
    error = function(e) cat(
      "  Skipped — aliased coefficient (interaction not estimable):",
      conditionMessage(e), "\n"
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
#SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS ON EARNINGS/EMPLOYMENT FINDINGS
#If TIP is associated with increase in employment, is that was is driving
#earnings differences? Or are the earnings differences also seen between
#graduates and non-graduates who are employed

#filter wide data to those who were employed partial year
daw_emp  <- daw %>% filter(employed_partial_year == 1)

#filter wide data to those who were employed full year
daw_full_emp <- daw %>% filter(employed_full_year == 1)

#Earnings model conditional on partial employment
ols_earn_cond_a <- feols(
  log(earnings_year_adj) ~ graduated_tip + graduated_tip:cohort_2022 |
    tip_id + year,
  cluster = ~tip_id, data = daw_emp
)
cat("Log earnings | any employment (annual):\n")
print(summary(ols_earn_cond_a))
```


```{r}
#Earnings OLS conditional on ful employment
ols_earn_full_cond_a <- feols(
  log(earnings_year_adj) ~ graduated_tip + graduated_tip:cohort_2022 |
    tip_id + year,
  cluster = ~tip_id, data = daw_full_emp
)
cat("\nLog earnings | full-year employment (annual):\n")
print(summary(ols_earn_full_cond_a))
```

```{r}
# Descriptive: mean annual earnings by group x pre/post, conditional on employment
daw %>%
  filter(employed_partial_year == 1) %>%
  mutate(period = if_else(rel_year >= 0, "post-exit", "pre-exit")) %>%
  group_by(treatment, cohort_2022, period) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_earn   = round(mean(earnings_year_adj), 0),
    median_earn = round(median(earnings_year_adj), 0),
    p25         = round(quantile(earnings_year_adj, 0.25), 0),
    p75         = round(quantile(earnings_year_adj, 0.75), 0),
    n_years     = n(),
    n_persons   = n_distinct(tip_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(cohort_2022, treatment, period) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
# Unconditional vs. conditional earnings comparison table
get_fe_safe <- function(model, term) {
  if (is.null(model)) return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
  ct <- summary(model)$coeftable
  if (is.null(ct) || !term %in% rownames(ct)) return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
  c(ct[term, "Estimate"], ct[term, "Pr(>|t|)"])
}

cat("\nUnconditional vs. conditional earnings:\n")
cat(sprintf("%-40s  %8s %6s\n", "", "Estimate", "p"))
for (row in list(
  list("Unconditional log-OLS (incl. zeros)",  ols_earn_a,           "graduated_tip"),
  list("Conditional: any employment",          ols_earn_cond_a,      "graduated_tip"),
  list("Conditional: full-year employment",    ols_earn_full_cond_a, "graduated_tip"),
  list("Uncond x2022+ interaction",            ols_earn_a,           "graduated_tip:cohort_2022"),
  list("Cond (any) x2022+ interaction",        ols_earn_cond_a,      "graduated_tip:cohort_2022"),
  list("Cond (full-year) x2022+ interaction",  ols_earn_full_cond_a, "graduated_tip:cohort_2022")
)) {
  r <- get_fe_safe(row[[2]], row[[3]])
  cat(sprintf("%-40s  %8.3f %6.3f\n", row[[1]], r[1], r[2]))
  
}
```
```{r}
#Convert OLS earnings estimates to dollars
# Get mean predicted earnings for non-graduates (control) in your window
control_mean <- daw %>%
  filter(graduated_tip == 0) %>%
  summarise(mean_earn = mean(earnings_year_adj, na.rm = TRUE))
print(control_mean)

# Then the implied dollar effect is roughly:
# (e^0.595 - 1) * control_mean
# BUT this is still an approximation given the +1 we did when logging

# Dollar estimate for 2022 cohort treatment effect
beta_main    <- coef(ols_earn_a)["graduated_tip"]
beta_2022    <- coef(ols_earn_a)["graduated_tip:cohort_2022"]
beta_total   <- beta_main + beta_2022

control_mean_2022 <- daw %>%
  filter(graduated_tip == 0, cohort_2022 == 1) %>%
  summarise(mean_earn = mean(earnings_year_adj, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(mean_earn)

dollar_effect_2022 <- (exp(beta_total) - 1) * control_mean_2022

cat("2022 cohort log coefficient:", round(beta_total, 3), "\n")
cat("2022 cohort control mean earnings: $", round(control_mean_2022), "\n")
cat("Implied dollar effect: $", round(dollar_effect_2022), "\n")

dollar_effect_2022_only <- (exp(beta_2022) - 1) * control_mean_2022

cat("2022 interaction log coefficient:", round(beta_2022, 3), "\n")
cat("Implied additional dollar effect from 2022 cohort: $", round(dollar_effect_2022_only), "\n")
```


Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
